decision_rule: No interpretation below 0.90 confidence becomes binding without a follow-up owner decision.

approved_direction.next_30_day_primary_objective: Make the 48-critique pilot fully operational and obtain real expert ratings.
approved_direction.development_mode: Continue product development while repairing failures; the pilot workflow remains the primary delivery priority.
approved_direction.pre_outreach_gate: Before contacting raters, pass the full production-path verification covering authentication, eligibility, blind assignment, autosave, submission, duplicate prevention, immutable initial ratings, revisions, adjudication, exports, audit logs, privacy boundaries, and interruption recovery. A separate external-tester mock-run requirement is not owner-selected.

pilot.purpose: Validate operations and produce preliminary evidence about rating time, agreement, disagreement causes, and adjudication demand.
pilot.source: Twelve public synthetic positions with their four existing critiques each.
pilot.benchmark_status: Permanent public development and workflow-validation set; never represented as a hidden benchmark.
provenance_stages: Stage 1: operational pilot using existing public synthetic material.
Stage 2: later balanced measurement pilot with controlled human/model provenance.
pilot.eligible_raters: Philosophy doctoral students, postdoctoral researchers, and recent PhDs, plus exceptional masters-level, independent, AI-safety, decision-theory, legal-theory, or adjacent researchers who pass a stricter calibration.
pilot.recruitment_channels: Targeted individual invitations plus open public recruitment, both blocked until production-workflow and pre-outreach gates pass.
pilot.senior_researcher_scope: Review the protocol and 8–12 public calibration cases, identify methodological problems, recommend early-career raters, and optionally review a small capped number of difficult cases. No routine bulk-rating request.
pilot.presentation: Hide source and author metadata and present all four critiques of one position sequentially.
adjudication_triggers: absolute overall-score difference of at least 0.30
absolute difference of at least 0.30 in strength multiplied by centrality
incompatible interpretations of the position or critique
disagreement over whether the critique is assessable
pilot.revision_policy: Never overwrite an initial rating; preserve every version, require an object-level revision reason, and create a separate adjudicated label snapshot.
pilot.completion_standard: Operational and research-operations pass: zero unresolved P0 defects; all critiques double-rated or validly replaced; original and revised ratings preserved; every triggered case adjudicated or explicitly unresolved; rating-time, agreement, disagreement causes, usability, burden, and a reproducible frozen export reported.

product_direction.model: Hybrid product strategy with Metaphilosophy Review as the first priority.
product_direction.audience_architecture: Separate audience-specific routes with one dominant homepage audience, still to be selected.
public_capabilities_before_full_benchmar: browse the clearly labeled unrated synthetic library
submit candidate critiques segregated from expert-rated data
submit non-expert ratings stored separately from expert labels

phase_2_and_funding.candidate_generation: High-quality candidate-critique generation may continue and is not treated as the principal capacity bottleneck.
phase_2_and_funding.first_major_funding_scope: The 400-critique Hard Set, benchmark validation, and one paper.
phase_2_and_funding.application_timing_model: Different timing by funder; exact timing remains unresolved.
phase_2_and_funding.submission_control: No funding application may be submitted without Ellen Sun's explicit approval.
phase_2_and_funding.payment_vehicle: Ellen Sun pays participants personally; payer jurisdiction and payment-account jurisdiction remain unresolved.
long_term_priority_ranking: Build a large expert-rated training dataset that measurably improves AI reasoning.
Build a widely used public platform for structured philosophy.
Build a durable expert-review institution producing recurring datasets and benchmarks.

schedule_targets.classification: owner targets, not evidence that readiness has passed

clarifications_required.question: Which audience should dominate the homepage: prospective expert raters, AI-safety and AI-evaluation researchers, funders and institutional partners, or general philosophy users?

Candidate critiques can be generated without a content bottleneck, but the expert-rated dataset still requires human ratings. What should authorize expert validation of all 400 critiques: explicit owner approval after Pilot 01, enough committed qualified rater capacity, external funding, or another rule?
Which funder should receive a submission before Pilot 01 results, after senior feedback, or only after Pilot 01 results? No submission will occur without a separate explicit approval.

Does 'Pilot rating begin: 2026-08-05' mean the first real research rating, the first calibration task, or the first internal synthetic rehearsal? The current audited workflow is not yet ready for real research ratings.

immediate_next_step: Build and verify the authenticated staging rater journey against the complete pre-outreach gate. Continue candidate-critique and public-submission work only where it does not delay that critical path.
